description: GLM-5.3-Flash on two DGX Sparks with TensorFold's native Zig/CUDA server (TensorFold 1.1.9, upstream f350cd3e plus MiaAI-Lab's 121 engine patches), one rank per Spark over the ConnectX-7 link with RoCE all-gathers that use both PCIe links of the cabled QSFP port when the platform's fabric setup passes both RoCE devices (the engine takes up to two from NCCL_IB_HCA). Serves MiaAI-Lab's EXL3 4 bpw TensorFold checkpoint (EXL3 routed experts, BF16 elsewhere; Mia-AiLab/GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3-4bpw-TensorFold at the revision the kit pins) with the kit's served settings: a 1,048,576-token window, 8 concurrent requests sharing an FP8 KV pool of 512-row pages, 8-bit dense and head weights, DFlash2 drafts at 4 bits, image input (up to 50 images a request; the default image has no video runtime), tool calling and structured outputs, a default reply budget of 32,768 tokens, thinking off by default with reasoning effort Max when a request turns it on, and earlier turns' reasoning dropped from the prompt. Based on MiaAI-Lab's GLM-5.3-Flash DGX Sparks kit 1104 at commit 80be4d68 (Apache-2.0), which supersedes her earlier two-Spark TensorFold kit; the creator publishes no image of it, so the recipe builds her Dockerfile (CUDA 13.3.1, Zig 0.17.0, sm_121) with her patches vendored, with a baseline-CPU Zig target because the image is built on a hosted arm64 runner, and without her optional video runtime. The kit's single-stream and aggregate rates, prefill rates and memory figures are upstream claims, not measured here; per Spark the kit reports about 83.3 GiB of model, 12.5 GiB of KV pool, 3.6 GiB of prompt cache and a 9.5 GiB reserve kept free. Licences, for information: the quantization is Apache-2.0 per the kit's NOTICE, with Z.AI's MIT licence kept for the base model; the DFlash2 drafter is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (non-commercial) and is not used with the MTP drafter option. Thinking is chosen per request: a request can set reasoning_effort or chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking, and reasoning comes back in reasoning_content.
title: GLM 5.3 Flash EXL3 DFlash2 TensorFold two Sparks
